bio_en: Alexander Petrosian, known as Peto, gave up a quiet career as a teacher and the support of his needy parents to enter the revolutionary field in 1890, and was the first of the ARF comrades to set foot in Ottoman Armenia. In 1892 he came from the Caucasus to Vaspurakan to organise the ARF, recruiting men such as Lorto and Akhper, and remembered as an organiser of unbending will and an honest heart from Aygestan to Alexandropol and Tiflis. In 1896 he and his whole band were killed. Rostom wrote his eulogy in Droshak in September 1896.
